title: Tintin: A Unified Hardware Performance Profiling Infrastructure to Uncover and Manage Uncertainty
problem: Modern hardware has intrinsic performance variability and uncertainty; existing profiling tools lack unified frameworks to characterize and manage this uncertainty across different hardware platforms and workloads.
motivation: Understanding and managing hardware performance uncertainty is critical for reliable system performance prediction, capacity planning, and optimization in cloud environments.
method: Tintin systematically measures how hardware performance changes when you run the same code multiple times and across different platforms, then tracks down what causes these variations (like temperature shifts or processor states). It quantifies the uncertainty in these performance measurements by analyzing the variability data. This lets you understand how reliable your performance predictions are and catch cases where they're likely to be wrong.
key_novelty: Tintin unifies hardware performance profiling across different platforms to measure variability and manage uncertainty in a single system.
contributions: Uncertainty quantification methodology for performance metrics
Tools and frameworks to manage performance variability
limitations: Effectiveness depends on completeness of profiling; may not capture all sources of variability in complex systems.
